theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_fa_sector_open_contDiffOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ), IsOpen {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x : Euclid P => (‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a))) {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a}
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
